name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Console Arcs
summary:
A mod that ports the console arcs from different versions of Higurashi When They Cry made by the 07th-Mod staff.
These arcs are exclusive to the PS2, DS, PS3, and Switch versions of different Higurashi When They Cry ports, and this is the only way to play it on PC.
This mod contains:
Taraimawashi
Tsukiotoshi
Someutsushi
Kageboushi
Yoigoshi
Tokihogushi-hen
Miotsukushi Ura
Miotsukushi Omote
Kotohogushi
Hajisarashi
